label: Bladderquill
description: A knee-high fan of stiff translucent quills, each fat at the base with stored water, standing in arcs along the green ring. Cut a quill and it sloshes. It bears the bladder-fruit -- food and drink in one object -- and is the visible promise of the green ring: where bladderquill stands, nobody dies thirsty.
